name: digi-pet
description: A Digimon V-Pet above the prompt that eats this session's prompt cache and grows from your work: it gets hungry before the cache goes cold, rests at lunch and at night, and digivolves by Digital Monster Color's rules from your turns, tests, commits and care

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: How long this session's prompt cache lives after a request: 60 on a 1-hour cache, 5 on the default one

restHours.title: Rest hours
restHours.description: Local windows when the pet naps: no hunger, no alerts, and a cache gone cold is no care mistake. Comma-separated HH:MM-HH:MM; a window may run past midnight

dayStartsHour.title: Day starts at (hour)
dayStartsHour.description: The hour a working day begins, so a late night counts as the evening before

sidePaths.title: Side-work folders
sidePaths.description: Comma-separated globs (~/work/personal/**): sessions started under them are side sessions, where the pet does not get hungry. /digi side toggles it per session

minContextTokens.title: Smallest cache worth minding (tokens)
minContextTokens.description: Below this much context the pet does not get hungry: a small cache is cheap to rebuild

notify.title: macOS notifications
notify.description: Notify when the pet is hungry or starving, so you hear about it from another app

pace.title: Growth pace
pace.description: How long every stage lasts: fast (a quarter as long), normal or slow (twice as long)

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Draw the pet and the fight still, with no animation
